text: This report summarizes the program items at the Community Liaison Meeting held both in person and virtually on June 3, 2026. Co-Hosting the meeting was Board Members Sharleen Ahmed and Malcolm Bromley. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Don Boyle - Chief Executive Officer, Kelvin Seow - Chief People and Strategy Officer, Hughena Walsh – Director, Sales and Marketing, Prashant Bhalja - Director, Capital Works, Tony Porter - Director, Security and Transportation, Fiona Crawford - Records and Archives Supervisor, Catherine de Nobriga – Tenant and Community Relations Coordinator, Nigel Fernandes - IT Systems, and Debbie Sanderson – Executive Assistant to the CEO. Twenty-three (23) community members attended the meeting; twenty (20) in person and three (3) virtually. The meeting concluded in just under 2 hours.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (September 2, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
